change.description: Add module-owned PostgreSQL storage, online background migration and observable bounded cutover while retaining SQLite control modules and existing proxy contracts.
change.release_unit_description: Future migration-capable application; this design-only change does not implement or release the capability.

planned.reasoning: Compatible migration status/control capabilities may be added; existing proxy APIs remain compatible. Older binaries cannot safely write an installation whose module authority has moved to PostgreSQL.

scope_drift.description: Current design follows module-based runtime migration with per-table progress and a short module switch gate.

current.reasoning: Design classification only; no runtime compatibility or cutover evidence exists yet.

public_api.change: Compatible progress/control additions; existing proxy, HTTP and SSE semantics retained. Migration-related task deferrals and data quality must be explicit.
public_api.supported_consumer_range: Existing same-Major clients; implementation verification pending.

persistent_state.state_description: SQLite/PostgreSQL module authority, new durable capture/checkpoint state, preserved business and recovery identities; old program writes must be fenced.
persistent_state.source_program_compatibility_range: Initial source 4.13.11 only; fixtures and runtime verification pending.
